routes.title: Pegasus neck through Enif to M15
routes.human_guidance: Use the Great Square to identify Markab, follow the neck stars Homam and Biham to Enif, then continue the same line a little more than 4° to M15.

sources.name: EarthSky — Pegasus the Flying Horse
